affected.note: Credit card data (cardholder name, number, expiry, security code) of customers who paid by card on IKETEI ONLINE between 2020-02-24 and 2024-10-15, possibly with some fraudulent use. A database holding 90,513 other personal records (name, address, email, phone, order and member data) was accessible to the attacker, but log analysis found no outflow of that data.

summary.en: Bag maker Iketei was told by a card company on 2025-02-26 of a possible card data leak from its IKETEI ONLINE store, and an investigation found that attackers had exploited a vulnerability to tamper with the payment application. It said card data of 30,712 customers may have leaked.
summary.ja: 鞄メーカーのイケテイは2025年2月26日、カード会社から「IKETEI ONLINE」利用者のカード情報漏えい懸念の連絡を受け、調査の結果、脆弱性を突いた不正アクセスで決済アプリケーションが改ざんされていたことが判明した。30,712件のクレジットカード情報が漏えいした可能性があると公表した。
